workloads.name: falcor-scalar-vector-select
workloads.preserved_shape: select(Bool, float3, float3) -> float3. The original condition is constant false. A dynamic scalar condition tests the same whole-vector choice; an explicitly splatted bool3 condition is the per-lane control.
workloads.desired_semantics: Scalar condition chooses an entire vector: false returns n, true returns -n. Constant entry always returns n. Dynamic and vector-control entries return n at index zero, -n otherwise.
workloads.initial_application_observation: E52017: unsupported select during first scene.update(), inside compute_triangle_max_emission -> make_emission_surface_interaction -> Scene.make_triangle_surface_interaction
workloads.scope: Compile/assemble reproducer has authored regressions. Separate numeric/Boolean family GPU fixture qualifies scalar selection. Current application blocker is recorded in falcor2-status.json.
